summary: The [preprint sex-DE plot](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/549725v1.supplementary-material) compares 530 individual P10 cells by sex. HypoExplorer excludes the Apoe and Pomc clusters, then compares 467 retained neurons aggregated into three male and three female mouse pseudobulks. No public author result matched that cohort and replication unit. The proposal is complete, and no ledger was edited.
openIssues: Reopen if the authors release gene-level sex effects for the 467 Figure 2 cells analyzed with mice as replicates.

The current compressed GEO SOFT metadata differ from the historical checksum. The cause is undetermined. All six sample records reconcile with the registered cohort, and the count archive and Figure 2 cell map match their historical hashes.
